**Grant Application: Everytown Safety Fund**

**Organization:** Glocks and Fried Chicken (GAFC)
**Amount Requested:** $150,000

Glocks and Fried Chicken (GAFC) is a minority-owned social enterprise committed to providing culturally relevant gun safety education to tackle gun violence in Sacramento's communities of color.

Communities of color in Sacramento are disproportionately impacted by gun violence and accidental firearm incidents. A critical gap exists in accessible, culturally resonant safety education. GAFC fills this void, offering a trusted resource for vital prevention where traditional programs often fall short.

Our innovative approach includes "Gloxsie 21," an engaging cartoon IP delivering age-appropriate safety lessons to youth. We complement this with practical AI education, demystifying technology's role in safety, and community workshops delivered through our trusted partner, Church of Legacy, directly engaging families on safe firearm storage and conflict resolution.

Funding will enable GAFC to educate 500+ residents annually. We project increased gun safety knowledge, responsible firearm practices, and a tangible reduction in preventable incidents, fostering safer homes within these vulnerable communities.

As a minority-owned and community-embedded social enterprise, GAFC possesses unique cultural competency and trust. Our partnership with Church of Legacy ensures deep community penetration. Our innovative, multi-faceted programs and community embeddedness drive lasting, positive change from within.

We respectfully request critical funding ($150,000) to scale GAFC's vital work, aligning perfectly with Everytown's mission to make every community safer.
